\section[(dialogue)]{Owning and being able — a first pass}

\label{lesson:PA-R116-first-pass-owning-and-being-able}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a bucket and a broom.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item this much, that much, like this, like that, other
  \item an expert, knowledge, to be able to, near, strength
  \item power, a right, authority, a chance, property
  \item wealth, an owner, experience, a habit, a skill
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
This much? (\textbf{\pa{ਇੰਨਾ}}, \emph{innā}.) That much? (\textbf{\pa{ਉੰਨਾ}}, \emph{unnā}.) Like this? (\textbf{\pa{ਇਵੇਂ}}, \emph{ivẽ}.) Like that? (\textbf{\pa{ਉਵੇਂ}}, \emph{uvẽ}.) Other? (\textbf{\pa{ਹੋਰ}}, \emph{hor}.) An expert? (\textbf{\pa{ਮਾਹਰ}}, \emph{māhar}.) Knowledge? (\textbf{\pa{ਜਾਣਕਾਰੀ}}, \emph{jāṇkārī}.) To be able to? (\textbf{\pa{ਸਕਣਾ}}, \emph{sakṇā}.) Near? (\textbf{\pa{ਕੋਲ}}, \emph{kol}.) Strength? (\textbf{\pa{ਤਾਕਤ}}, \emph{tākat}.) Power? (\textbf{\pa{ਸ਼ਕਤੀ}}, \emph{shaktī}.) A right? (\textbf{\pa{ਹੱਕ}}, \emph{hakk}.) Authority? (\textbf{\pa{ਅਧਿਕਾਰ}}, \emph{adhikār}.) A chance? (\textbf{\pa{ਮੌਕਾ}}, \emph{maukā}.) Property? (\textbf{\pa{ਜਾਇਦਾਦ}}, \emph{jāidād}.) Wealth? (\textbf{\pa{ਦੌਲਤ}}, \emph{daulat}.) An owner? (\textbf{\pa{ਮਾਲਕ}}, \emph{mālak}.) Experience? (\textbf{\pa{ਤਜਰਬਾ}}, \emph{tajarbā}.) A habit? (\textbf{\pa{ਆਦਤ}}, \emph{ādat}.) A skill? (\textbf{\pa{ਹੁਨਰ}}, \emph{hunar}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Things in the house — a second pass}

\label{lesson:PA-R116-second-pass-things-in-the-house}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for an art and a tool.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item an art, a tool, ability, to win, to lose
  \item an umbrella, a bowl, a glass, a cooking pot, a comb
  \item soap, a towel, a mattress, a bedsheet, a blanket
  \item a quilt, a stove, a vessel, scissors, a needle
  \item a thread, a button, a nail, a bucket, a broom
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
An art? (\textbf{\pa{ਕਲਾ}}, \emph{kalā}.) A tool? (\textbf{\pa{ਸੰਦ}}, \emph{sand}.) Ability? (\textbf{\pa{ਲਿਆਕਤ}}, \emph{liākat}.) To win? (\textbf{\pa{ਜਿੱਤਣਾ}}, \emph{jittṇā}.) To lose? (\textbf{\pa{ਹਾਰਨਾ}}, \emph{hārnā}.) An umbrella? (\textbf{\pa{ਛਤਰੀ}}, \emph{chatrī}.) A bowl? (\textbf{\pa{ਕੌਲੀ}}, \emph{kaulī}.) A glass? (\textbf{\pa{ਗਲਾਸ}}, \emph{galās}.) A cooking pot? (\textbf{\pa{ਪਤੀਲਾ}}, \emph{patīlā}.) A comb? (\textbf{\pa{ਕੰਘੀ}}, \emph{kanghī}.) Soap? (\textbf{\pa{ਸਾਬਣ}}, \emph{sābaṇ}.) A towel? (\textbf{\pa{ਤੌਲੀਆ}}, \emph{tauliā}.) A mattress? (\textbf{\pa{ਗੱਦਾ}}, \emph{gaddā}.) A bedsheet? (\textbf{\pa{ਚਾਦਰ}}, \emph{cādar}.) A blanket? (\textbf{\pa{ਕੰਬਲ}}, \emph{kambal}.) A quilt? (\textbf{\pa{ਰਜਾਈ}}, \emph{rajāī}.) A stove? (\textbf{\pa{ਚੁੱਲ੍ਹਾ}}, \emph{cullhā}.) A vessel? (\textbf{\pa{ਭਾਂਡਾ}}, \emph{bhā̃ḍā}.) Scissors? (\textbf{\pa{ਕੈਂਚੀ}}, \emph{kaĩcī}.) A needle? (\textbf{\pa{ਸੂਈ}}, \emph{sūī}.) A thread? (\textbf{\pa{ਧਾਗਾ}}, \emph{dhāgā}.) A button? (\textbf{\pa{ਬਟਨ}}, \emph{baṭan}.) A nail? (\textbf{\pa{ਕਿੱਲ}}, \emph{kill}.) A bucket? (\textbf{\pa{ਬਾਲਟੀ}}, \emph{bālṭī}.) A broom? (\textbf{\pa{ਝਾੜੂ}}, \emph{jhāṛū}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
